overview: The big thread today was Satya Nadella's essay on containing superintelligence. Sacks, Suleyman, Chamath and Musk all weighed in, and Sacks used it to attack Anthropic's alignment approach. Elsewhere, Musk pushed Grok @Bot as a shopping and commerce agent and fought with Ambani over Starlink pricing in India. Burry-watchers flagged bubble and housing warnings. Politics posts (Ukraine, the NY AG race, protests) were skipped.

top_items.title: chamath - Says Satya's essay shows verification will gate how fast superintelligence enters enterprises; predicts a new 'system of record' to track AI changes
DavidSacks - Argues Anthropic's Claude Constitution, which lets the model act as a 'conscientious objector,' makes AI less safe, not more
burrytracker - Burry says Anthropic's private valuation could buy 78 profitable S&P 500 companies, including Domino's, Clorox and Lululemon
elonmusk - Says Grok @Bot can take a photo of your credit card, hunt the web for the best deal and place the order; he claims it bought his LEGO
chamath - Agrees IP and software were 'effectively rendered worthless' after people decompiled Adobe's five core products and released open-source versions
elonmusk - Hits back at 'Ambani's shills,' saying SpaceX will have to price Starlink affordably in India or no one will buy it
tobi - Endorses Patrick Collison's essay on agents in the economy: 'Personal agents will…act as a kind of structural subsidy for product quality'
